title: Conflating Incompatible Domain Contexts
pattern: Carrying fields that are irrelevant to a specific processing context because of merging distinct conceptual scopes.
why_bad: It causes ambiguity and context dilution. It degrades system cohesion, forces records to contain sparse data, and complicates indexing or performance because of irrelevant metadata.
detection: Struct declarations containing a large mix of metadata fields that are unrelated to the core function of the system.
fix:
Divide domain records into explicit context scopes, mapping them only at boundary translation points.
```rust
struct PayrollEmployee {
    id: u64,
    salary: Decimal,
}
```
source: *Data and Reality* by William Kent & Steve Hoberman (p. 55-56, 335).
